Inserting this into weighted covariance identity yields claimed 1/(2C) sum pairwise error gap, uniformly bounded integrands with no moment condition. Monotonic s versus c gives flat-sign minimum, inverse c=s^{-1} gives reversal, power c=s^(2q+1) gives min and sharp factor-two; rational symmetrized examples independently checked and q=0 factor-two algebra reviewed. Finite checks are corroborative, not proof.
